title: flow_external_worker_job_complete input
description: Input for reporting an acquired external worker job as done. The variables become process variables, so the following BPMN steps can read the worker's result.

workerId.title: Worker id
workerId.description: Identity of the worker holding the lock — the engine rejects a report from anyone else.

variables.description: Result variables: shorthand map {name: value} or explicit list [{name,value,type}].

apiConfiguration.description: Optional Flowable ApiConfiguration selector (full or partial UUID).
